haikus.haiku:
Gentle paws tap light
Purring hums fill quiet rooms
Sunlit fur glows warm
Happy #NationalCatDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning sun pours oat
Steam curls, sweet cinnamon drifts
Creamy bowl glows warm
Happy #NationalOatmealDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle candle glow
Pages turn with soft light near
Joy rings in each word
#HappyBirthdayJamesBoswell from @ClamBakeSanta
